# STEP fixture provenance (ADR 0172, R098.a; finalised in R098.d)

Every file in this directory is a repository fixture for the STEP tests (`tests/ifc_step_tests.cpp`,
`tests/ifc_step_worker_tests.py`, `tests/ifc_step_export_tests.cpp`, `tests/step_import_tests.cpp`,
`tests/step_import_dialog_tests.cpp` and `tests/step_export_dialog_tests.cpp`). None is installed in
the package.

**Licence.** No file here is third-party. Each was written by this repository's OCCT 7.9.3 writer or
by hand from the files that were, so each file is under the repository's own licence (MIT, the
`LICENSE` file). The fixtures carry no notice of another author. **No third-party file is in the
corpus.** ADR 0172 section 7, item 3, asks for a small third-party set with named sources and
licences; owner decision 10 says that the corpus stands on the self-generated files if none can
be licensed cleanly. The candidates were checked as follows, in R098.d:

- **NIST CAD interoperability test cases** (the PMI test cases, CAD models and STEP files on the NIST
  MBE PMI validation pages): the NIST download page says the files "can be used without any
  restrictions" and asks for acknowledgement if they are used, and the data.gov record points to
  NIST's general open-licence page. **Not downloaded or verified in R098.d**: no file was taken, so
  the hosting and the licence terms are not confirmed here.
- **FreeCAD test data** and **OCCT's own test resources**: not checked in R098.d. ADR 0172 records
  both as unverified at design time, and they remain so.

**Origin classes.** *Generated* means written by `sketchyup-ifc-worker --write-step`, the
repository's own generator (`src/ifc/step_probe.cpp`). *Hand-written* means the text was typed or
edited by hand; no program wrote it. *Hand-edited* means the file was written by the OCCT writer and
its coordinates or units were then changed by hand.

| file | origin | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `sketchyup-step-box.step` | generated | a box 10 x 20 x 30 mm at the origin (the basic writer, AP214) |
| `sketchyup-step-cylinder.step` | generated | a cylinder of radius 5 and height 20 mm at the origin |
| `sketchyup-step-assembly.step` | generated | an assembly of the box and the cylinder |
| `sketchyup-step-placed.step` | generated | the box translated by (5, 10, 15) mm; the writer bakes the location into the coordinates |
| `sketchyup-step-mirror.step` | generated | the box under a point symmetry about the OX line (y and z flip, a rotation of 180 degrees, determinant +1); the name is historical, this file is not a mirror image |
| `sketchyup-step-instanced.step` | generated (XDE writer) | one part (the box) placed three times at (50, 0, 0), (0, 50, 0) and (0, 0, 50) mm: the assembly structure of R098.b |
| `sketchyup-step-named.step` | generated (XDE writer) | four free products: `Bracket` (a box), `Bolt` (a cylinder), a box with a 3,000-character name (the 2,048-byte cap), and an unnamed cylinder (the reader names it `SOLID`) |
| `sketchyup-step-colored.step` | generated (XDE writer) | a red box and an unstyled cylinder (the default grey, with its notice) |
| `sketchyup-step-layered.step` | generated (XDE writer) | a box on the layer `LayerA` and a cylinder the XDE marks invisible |
| `inch-units.step` | hand-written | the corpus box with the context's unit replaced by `CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('INCH')`: 254 x 508 x 762 mm at import |
| `spaced-units.step` | hand-written | the unit entities with spaces in the parts (`SI_UNIT ( .MILLI., .METRE. )`), no shapes |
| `sketchyup-step-placed-assembly.step` | hand-written | the assembly fixture with the box's placement offset to (50, 0, 0) mm |
| `mirror-box.step` | generated by a one-off program (`make_mirror_box.cpp` in this directory) | the box mirrored in the YZ plane (x -> -x), so a det -1 solid with its coordinates at negative x. Regenerated in R098.d; see below |
| `box-negative.step` | hand-edited | written by the XDE writer (its product is `Open CASCADE STEP translator 7.9 1`, protocol `1 0`), then the box's x coordinates were moved to [-10, 0] by hand. The command that wrote the original is not in the repository |

**`mirror-box.step` was regenerated in R098.d.** The file committed by R098.a2 (`cb2f4bf3...`, dated
2026-10-24) was hand-edited from the basic writer's box, and it was malformed in two ways that a
reader can tolerate without noticing: every `ADVANCED_FACE` line had lost its comma and its
same-sense attribute (`#32.T.` where `#32,.T.` was meant, so each face carried three attributes),
and the negated coordinates were written as integers (`-10,` where a real `-10.,` is required). It
is replaced by the output of `make_mirror_box.cpp` (`ba3d4f6f...`): six faces with explicit sense
flags, a closed shell, and the same geometry (x in [-10, 0], the signed volume positive and exact).
The tests of R098.a2 and R098.b (the mirror checks in `tests/ifc_step_tests.cpp` and
`tests/ifc_step_worker_tests.py`) pass on the new file. The old file is in the git history.

**Schemas and writers.** The basic writer's files declare `AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN { 1 2 10303 214 0 1 1 1 }`
(AP214IS); the XDE writer's files declare `AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN { 1 0 10303 214 1 1 1 1 }`, and so does
`mirror-box.step`, which the R098.d program wrote with the `STEPControl_Writer` default of this
build. The hand-written files keep the schema of the file they came from. Units are declared in
millimetres (the writer's default), except `inch-units.step`, which declares inches through the
conversion unit. Angles are RADIAN. The OCCT version is 7.9.3 for every writer output.

**Generator.** `sketchyup-ifc-worker --write-step tests/fixtures/step` writes the nine generated
corpus files (the box, cylinder, assembly, placed, mirror, instanced, named, colored and layered;
commit `f1ad42f8`, the build of 2026-10-23 in `sketchyup-ci-pinned:r097a-ifc`, and the XDE files of
R098.b). The `FILE_NAME` carries a wall-clock timestamp, so a fresh write is not byte-identical to the
committed files; the tests use the files as regression inputs and check the second write's sizes for
determinism. `make_mirror_box.cpp` is not built by CMake; its header gives the one-line build in the
pinned image.

The list is a record: the test suites read the files, not these hashes.

**Geometry ground truth.** The box's bounding box is (0,0,0)-(10,20,30) mm and it has six faces; the
cylinder is one solid with three faces; the assembly is one shape with two solids. The inch fixture
is the same box in inches: (0,0,0)-(254,508,762) mm at import (25.4 mm per unit). The placed fixture's
bounding box is (5,10,15)-(15,30,45) mm; the mirror's is (0,-20,-30)-(10,0,0) mm for
`sketchyup-step-mirror.step` (the point symmetry), and `mirror-box.step` is (-10,0,0)-(0,20,30) mm.
The placed-assembly's box is (-5,-5,0)-(60,20,30) mm with the cylinder at the origin. The instanced
fixture is one shape with three solids and eighteen faces at the import (the XDE read); its
basic-reader bounding box is (0,0,0)-(60,70,80) mm.
